title: Maker winning strategy for Snaky on the infinite square lattice
exact_target:
In the unbiased Maker–Breaker game on the initially empty lattice $\mathbb Z^2$, can Maker force the six-cell Snaky polyomino
\[\{(0,0),(1,0),(2,0),(3,0),(3,1),(4,1)\}\]
up to translation, rotation or reflection against every legal Breaker strategy?

\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
In the unbiased Maker–Breaker game on the initially empty lattice $\mathbb Z^2$, can Maker force the six-cell Snaky polyomino
\[\{(0,0),(1,0),(2,0),(3,0),(3,1),(4,1)\}\]
up to translation, rotation or reflection against every legal Breaker strategy?
